D012: Fear and avoidance behaviors due to direct and primary fear of the specific object or situation itself.
D016: Fear of a specific object or situation occurs as a result of obsessive thoughts, accompanied by compulsive behaviors.

D012.key_difference: Whether criteria for PTSD are met

D012: Fear of a specific object/situation may be experienced after a traumatic event, but diagnostic criteria for Posttraumatic Stress Disorder are not met.
D018: Fear of a specific object/situation is experienced after a traumatic event, and diagnostic criteria for Posttraumatic Stress Disorder are met.

D012.additional_condition: Fear of specific food or food-related situations (choking, vomiting)
D012.key_difference: Cause of fear and avoidance behaviors

D012: Avoidance (e.g., restriction of intake) due to direct fear of specific food or food-related situations.
D021: Fear or avoidance of specific food or food-related situations is based on fear of gaining weight.

D012.key_difference: Cause of fear and avoidance behaviors

D012: Fear and avoidance are based on realistic fear of the specific object or situation itself.
D005: Fear and avoidance are attributed to delusional thinking.
